description.en: A summer night seen from eye level: swaying tall grass, drifting fireflies, twinkling stars, and the odd shooting star.
description.zh: 平视视角的夏夜:随风摆动的长草、飘荡的萤火虫、闪烁的星星,偶尔有流星划过。

usage.en: It applies at session start. Run /firefly-meadow to switch to it, and /firefly-meadow off to go back to the app's own look.
usage.zh: 会话开始时自动应用。运行 /firefly-meadow 切换到它,/firefly-meadow off 恢复应用原本的外观。
